name: Lilycove City
lines:
I was away awhile, so I was surprised to see
there is an exhibit on the second floor, too.
I wish someone would paint my Pokémon
this pretty.

Well...this is where they display the paintings
that everyone has been talking about recently.
I see. These new paintings are indeed
full of vigor and are fascinating.

Wow, is that right? The models of portraits
here are your Pokémon.
Isn’t that just the ultimate joy for
a Trainer?

I think I saw the contest when
this portrait was painted!
I always watch your contests, though.
Thank you for always giving me
such a fun time!

Oh, it’s you!
I’m the curator here.
Do you remember me?
As I promised, I displayed your
Pokémon’s portrait art here!
Yes, just as I imagined, the modern
touch is pretty good, too.

Thanks to you, new styles have
been added to this museum.
I’m happy about that.

By the way...
Thanks to you, we were able to
display so many portraits.
Let me thank you properly.

The past, the present, and the future...
I’d like to collect all kinds of marvelous
art here in Lilycove Museum!

It looks like a place to display a portrait of a
Pokémon that performed well in a contest.
